user.title: Centrometal WiFi-Box (local)
user.description: Home Assistant will read the boiler through its own MQTT broker (e.g. the Mosquitto add-on). Point the WiFi-Box at that broker: redirect the DNS name portal.centrometal.hr to the broker host and let the broker accept the box's connection.

data.name: Name
data.product: Boiler type in the MQTT topic (e.g. biopl)
data.refresh_sign: Captured REFRESH _sign (optional, 40 hex) — leave empty unless you captured one from the real cloud; the integration then also probes that replay variant

abort.mqtt_unavailable: No MQTT broker is configured in Home Assistant. Set up the MQTT integration (e.g. the Mosquitto add-on) first.

error.invalid_sign: The _sign must be exactly 40 hexadecimal characters, or left empty.
